metadata.title: Logistics between Ireland and Cameroon
metadata.description: Request a quote and track shipments between Ireland and Cameroon. Every quote is prepared personally for your shipment.

hero.title: Air and sea freight between Ireland and Cameroon
hero.subtitle: Parcels, barrels, vehicles, containers and commercial goods in both directions, with customs clearance, storage and online-shopping forwarding when you need them. Tell us what you are sending and we will prepare a quote for your shipment.

services.heading: Our services
services.intro: Shipping by air and sea in both directions, and the customs, storage and shopping services that go with it. If what you need is not listed, ask us.

process.heading: How a quote works
process.step1Title: Tell us what you are sending
process.step1Body: Use the quote form: what the goods are, roughly how much, where they are now and where they need to go.
process.step2Body: If anything is unclear, we contact you before setting a price, so the quote matches what you actually send.
process.step3Body: The price, what it includes and how long it is valid. You decide whether to accept it; nothing is paid online.
process.step4Body: Once booked, your shipment gets an ML reference that you and the recipient can track.

about.heading: About Marchelo Logistics
about.body: Marchelo Logistics ships goods for families and businesses between Ireland and Cameroon, in English and in French.

guide.heading: Packing for a long journey
guide.body: Good packing protects your goods at sea and on the road. Read our guide to packing barrels and boxes, labelling them and listing what is inside.

final.heading: Talk to us in Ireland or in Cameroon
final.body: For a price, the quote form is the quickest way to send us the details we need. For anything else, call or write to us.

home.trackIntro: Follow a shipment with its ML reference. No account needed.

aboutPage.title: About us
aboutPage.intro: Marchelo Logistics is a logistics and freight-forwarding business working between Ireland and Cameroon, with an office in Lucan and a base in Douala.
aboutPage.howWeWork: Every quote is prepared personally for your specific shipment. Prices are never calculated automatically.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Prices, payment, customs, collection and using this website. For questions about a specific shipment, contact us.

price.q: How do I get a price?
price.a: Check our guide prices, then send a quote request with details of what you want to ship. We review it personally and send you a written quotation.

currency.q: Are your prices in euros, and do they include VAT?
currency.a: Yes. All our prices are in euros (EUR), and listed prices include applicable VAT.

individual.q: Why do some services need an individual quotation?
individual.a: Prices depend on the type of shipment, its weight, volume and destination. Certain destinations, vehicles, specific goods and commercial freight are always quoted individually.

when.a: For sea groupage, a 20% deposit is due at booking. Express freight is paid in full before dispatch. Any remaining balance must be paid before the shipment departs.

xaf.q: Can I pay in CFA francs (XAF)?
xaf.a: Only for shipments from Cameroon to Ireland.

customs.a: For parcels and personal effects, yes. Vehicle customs clearance is not included and is quoted separately. We also offer customs clearance services in Cameroon.

home.q: Can you collect from my home?
home.a: Yes, in the Dublin region, for a fixed fee shown on our prices page. Collection elsewhere in Ireland is quoted individually. You can also drop off your goods at a collection point: ask us where.

delivery.a: Yes. Barrels are delivered door to door in the main cities of Cameroon. Remote or other destinations may need an individual quotation.

storage.q: How long can my goods stay at your premises?
storage.a: 48 hours free of charge after they become available. After that, storage is charged per day, as shown on our prices page.

departures.a: We run an express shipment every month in each direction. The departure windows are:

prohibited.a: Some goods can never be shipped, such as weapons, explosives, hazardous chemicals and perishable food. See the full prohibited goods list in our shipping guide.

cancel.a: Yes, subject to conditions. A refund is available only if the shipment has not yet left our premises. This does not affect your statutory rights.

delay.q: What happens if my shipment is delayed?
delay.a: We tell you by telephone, WhatsApp or email.

account.a: No. You can request a quote and track a shipment without an account.

reference.q: Where do I find my tracking reference?
reference.a: Shipment references start with ML and are given to you when your shipment is booked. Quote request references start with QR.

languages.a: You can use the website in English or French.

privacyPage.draftNotice: Draft: this page describes what the website technically collects. The data controller details and retention periods are awaiting confirmation.
privacyPage.collect: When you request a quote: your name, email address, phone number (optional), the route and details of the items you describe, and your preferred language. When you have an account: your sign-in email and the records linked to it. Uploaded documents, if you choose to provide them.
privacyPage.use: To prepare and send your quote, to arrange and track your shipment, to contact you about it, and to keep a secure record of changes.
privacyPage.security: Data is stored in a database hosted in the European Union. Access is limited to you and to authorised staff. Documents are private and shared only through short-lived links.
privacyPage.cookies: We use only the cookies needed for language preference and, when you sign in, to keep you signed in. We do not use advertising or analytics cookies.
privacyPage.retention: Retention periods are being confirmed. Until then, nothing is deleted automatically.
privacyPage.rights: You can ask to access, correct or delete your personal data. Contact us using the details on our contact page.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.intro: From your first request to delivery at the destination, here is what happens and what we need from you at each stage.
howItWorks.step1Body: Use the quote form to tell us what you want to send. The more detail you give, the more accurate your quote.
howItWorks.step1Point1: What the items are and how many
howItWorks.step1Point2: Approximate size and weight, if you know them
howItWorks.step1Point3: Where the goods are now and where they need to go
howItWorks.step2Body: We check your request personally. If something is missing or unclear, we ask you before preparing a price, so you are not quoted for the wrong thing.
howItWorks.step3Body: Your quote shows the price, the currency, how long it stays valid, and what is included and excluded. You decide whether to accept it. Nothing is charged automatically.
howItWorks.step4Body: Once you accept, we agree with you how and when your goods are handed over for your shipment.
howItWorks.step5Body: Your shipment gets an ML reference. Each time our team records a step, it appears on the tracking page. These are the steps a shipment can go through:
howItWorks.step5Exceptions: If something holds a shipment up, it is shown as “Delayed” or “On hold”, and our team will explain what is happening.
howItWorks.step6Title: 6. Delivery or collection at the destination
howItWorks.step6Body: When your goods are ready, the tracking page shows whether they are ready for collection or out for delivery.

guide.title: Shipping guide
guide.intro: Practical advice for packing and preparing goods for the long journey between Ireland and Cameroon. This is general guidance: your quote confirms the details for your shipment.
guide.packing1: Use strong, rigid barrels or double-walled boxes. Old, soft boxes can collapse under the weight of other cargo.
guide.packing2: Put heavy items at the bottom and lighter items on top.
guide.packing3: Fill empty spaces with clothes, towels or packing material so nothing moves.
guide.packing4: Wrap fragile items individually and keep them away from the sides.
guide.packing5: Seal liquids in plastic bags in case a lid opens.
guide.packing6: Close barrels with their locking ring and tape every box seam.
guide.label1: Write the sender’s and the receiver’s full names and phone numbers on every barrel and box.
guide.label2: Number your pieces, for example 1 of 3, 2 of 3, 3 of 3.
guide.label3: Once your shipment is booked, add your ML reference to every piece.
guide.listBody: Write down what is in each barrel or box and its approximate value. You will need this information for your quote request and it helps if customs ask questions.
guide.rates1: Prices depend on the type of shipment, its weight, volume and destination.
guide.rates2: Express air freight is charged by the kilogram.
guide.rates3: Sea groupage and container prices depend on the volume or the category of goods.
guide.rates4: All our prices are in euros (EUR).
guide.rates5: Certain destinations, vehicles, specific goods and commercial freight need an individual quotation.
guide.payment1: We accept bank transfer and Revolut.
guide.payment2: Sea freight groupage: a 20% deposit is due at booking.
guide.payment3: Express freight: full payment is due before dispatch.
guide.payment4: Any remaining balance must be paid before the shipment departs.
guide.payment5: Payment in CFA francs (XAF) is accepted only for shipments from Cameroon to Ireland.
guide.customs2: Customs clearance is included for parcels and personal effects.
guide.customs3: Vehicle customs clearance is not included and is quoted separately.
guide.customs4: Customs authorities may inspect goods. Your quotation states what is included, so ask us if anything is unclear.
guide.collection1: You can drop off your goods at a collection point: ask us where.
guide.collection2: Home collection is available in the Dublin region for a fixed fee. Collection elsewhere in Ireland is quoted individually.
guide.collection3: We deliver in Cameroon. Remote or other destinations may need an individual quotation.
guide.collection4: Goods are kept free of charge for 48 hours once they are available at our premises. After that, storage is charged per day.
guide.cancel1: You can cancel a shipment, subject to conditions.
guide.cancel2: A refund is available only if the shipment has not yet left our premises.
guide.cancel3: If your shipment is delayed, we tell you by telephone, WhatsApp or email.
guide.cancel4: Our policy for lost or damaged goods is being finalised. Contact us straight away if there is a problem with your shipment.
guide.cancelNote: These are our own business policies. They do not affect your statutory rights.

servicesPage.intro: We ship by air and sea between Ireland and Cameroon, in both directions. Rates, transit times and conditions depend on each shipment, so every quote is prepared for you: ask us to confirm what applies to yours.

consent.bannerBody: This website uses only necessary cookies (language and sign-in). We use no analytics or advertising cookies. You can change your choice at any time from “Cookie preferences” at the bottom of the page.
consent.dialogIntro: Choose which categories of cookies you allow. Strictly necessary cookies are always on because the website cannot work without them. Optional categories stay off unless you switch them on.
consent.notInUse: Not used on this website at present.

necessary.title: Strictly necessary
necessary.description: Remember your language, keep you signed in to your account, protect password resets and remember your cookie choices.

functional.title: Functional
functional.description: Would remember optional settings or provide embedded features such as maps or chat.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Would help us understand, through statistics, how visitors use the website.

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.description: Would be used to show or measure advertising.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie policy
cookiePolicy.draftNotice: Draft awaiting legal review: this page lists the cookies the website actually sets today. It will be updated before any new tool is added.
cookiePolicy.intro: Cookies are small files that a website stores in your browser. This page lists every cookie this website sets, why it is needed and how long it is kept.
cookiePolicy.summary: This website uses only strictly necessary cookies. It does not use analytics, advertising or social media cookies, and it loads no third-party tracking scripts. Strictly necessary cookies do not require your consent, but we tell you about them here.
cookiePolicy.firstPartySupabase: Marchelo Logistics (this website), using our Supabase sign-in service

locale.purpose: Remembers the language you chose (English or French).

consentCookie.purpose: Records your cookie choices and the version of this policy you answered, so that we do not ask on every page.

session.name: sb-…-auth-token (may be split into numbered parts)
session.purpose: Keeps you signed in to your customer or staff account. Set only when you sign in and removed when you sign out.
session.duration: Up to 400 days, or until you sign out

verifier.name: sb-…-auth-token-code-verifier
verifier.purpose: Protects the password reset link you request, so that only your browser can complete the reset. Set only when you request a password reset.
verifier.duration: Up to 400 days, or until the reset is completed

cookiePolicy.optional: We do not currently use any functional, analytics or marketing cookies. If we add one in future, it will be listed here, it will be used only after you agree, and we will ask for your choice again.
cookiePolicy.manage: You can change or withdraw your choice at any time using “Cookie preferences” at the bottom of every page. You can also delete cookies in your browser settings; if you delete the strictly necessary cookies, you will be signed out and your language choice will be forgotten.
cookiePolicy.questions: If you have a question about cookies or your personal data, contact us using the details on our contact page. The privacy page explains how we use personal data.

catalogue.disclosure1: All prices are in euros (EUR) and are guide prices for shipments between Ireland and Cameroon.
catalogue.disclosure3: The final price depends on the type of shipment, its weight, volume and destination. We confirm it in the written quotation we send you.
catalogue.disclosure4: “From” prices are starting prices. “Individual quotation” means we prepare a price for your specific shipment. Certain destinations, vehicles, specific goods and commercial freight are always quoted individually.

clarification.P07: Is your screen exactly 55 inches? We confirm its price in your quotation.
clarification.P09: Free for the first 48 hours after your goods become available at our premises. Charged in CFA francs (XAF).

vehicles.title: Vehicle shipping
vehicles.intro: Guide prices by vehicle category, from Ireland to Cameroon.
vehicles.note1: Vehicle customs clearance is not included in the shipping price and is quoted separately.
vehicles.note2: Container shipping: personal effects may be left inside the vehicle. RORO (roll-on/roll-off) shipping: no personal effects may be left inside the vehicle.
vehicles.note3: The vehicle’s NCT must not have expired more than two years ago. If it expired more than two years ago, a technical conformity certificate is required.
vehicles.note4: The models listed are examples of each category. Tell us the exact make and model and we confirm the category in your quotation.

parcels.title: Parcels and personal effects
parcels.note1: Customs clearance is included for parcels and personal effects.
parcels.note2: There is no published price for parcels between 15 and 20 kg or over 50 kg: request a quote.

barrels.title: Barrels
barrels.intro: Barrels of household goods and personal belongings.
barrels.note1: Door-to-door delivery is available in the main cities of Cameroon. Other destinations are quoted individually.

cartons.title: Standard cartons
cartons.intro: Prices depend on the destination city.
cartons.note1: For destinations other than Douala and Yaoundé, request a quote.

furniture.title: Furniture and appliances
furniture.note1: Used, refurbished or second-hand electrical appliances are subject to a mandatory electrical certificate surcharge.

sea_freight.title: Sea freight
sea_freight.note1: Sea groupage and container prices depend on the volume or the category of goods.

air_freight.title: Air freight
air_freight.intro: Express air freight, charged by the kilogram.
air_freight.note1: Express air freight is charged by the kilogram.

collection.title: Collection, delivery and storage
collection.intro: Getting your goods to us, and to their destination.
collection.note1: You can also drop off your goods at a collection point: ask us where.

pricesPage.title: Prices
pricesPage.intro: Guide prices for our services between Ireland and Cameroon. Every shipment is confirmed in a written quotation.
pricesPage.ctaBody: Tell us what you are sending and we prepare your quotation.

serviceDetail.infoTitle: What to include in your quote request
serviceDetail.noPrices: This service is quoted individually. Tell us what you need and we prepare a price for you.
serviceDetail.quoteCta: Request a quote for this service
serviceDetail.collection1: Drop off your goods at a collection point: ask us where.
serviceDetail.collection2: Home collection in the Dublin region; collection elsewhere in Ireland is quoted individually.
serviceDetail.collection3: Delivery in Cameroon. Remote or other destinations may need an individual quotation.

air_freight.intro: Express air freight between Ireland and Cameroon, in both directions, charged by the kilogram.
air_freight.what1: Parcels and goods that need to travel quickly by air.
air_freight.option1: Express air freight from 1 kg, charged per kilogram.
air_freight.option2: A wholesale rate, on request, for shipments from 50 kg.
air_freight.info1: The approximate weight of each piece
air_freight.condition1: Lithium batteries must be declared. Damaged batteries cannot be shipped.

sea_freight.intro: Sea freight between Ireland and Cameroon: groupage for smaller volumes, and full 20-foot or 40-foot containers.
sea_freight.what1: Household goods, personal effects and commercial goods, shipped by volume.
sea_freight.condition1: Prices depend on the volume or the category of goods and are given in an individual quotation.
sea_freight.condition2: Groupage bookings require a 20% deposit at booking. The balance must be paid before the shipment departs.
sea_freight.info1: The volume in m³, or the dimensions of your goods

vehicle.condition2: Vehicle customs clearance is not included in the shipping price and is quoted separately.

prohibited.title: Prohibited goods
prohibited.intro: We do not ship the following goods:
prohibited.item1: Military uniforms, and tactical or military equipment
prohibited.item4: Hazardous chemicals, compressed gas, acids, corrosives, radioactive materials, fuels and flammable liquids
prohibited.item5: Undeclared lithium batteries, damaged batteries, non-compliant hoverboards or e-scooters, and unauthorised e-cigarettes
prohibited.item6: Narcotics, and medicines without a valid prescription
prohibited.item7: Perishable goods, and non-compliant meat or fish
prohibited.item8: Live animals, ivory, protected species, and trophies or skins without permits
prohibited.item9: Cash, undeclared gold, precious stones and travellers’ cheques
prohibited.item10: Counterfeit goods, pirated products and falsified documents
prohibited.item11: Industrial waste, infectious materials and toxic products
prohibited.item12: Any other goods prohibited by Cameroonian or EU regulations
prohibited.disclaimer: This list is not exhaustive and does not replace current customs and transport regulations. Ask us before packing anything you are unsure about.
